title: Individual Student License & Credentials
content: Course access is strictly individual and non-transferable. Sharing credentials, lecture recordings, or course notes with third parties violates institutional policy and results in immediate access revocation without refund.

title: Verification & Course Unlocking
content: Email verification confirms your student account. Course material unlocking is executed individually by academic administration upon receipt verification, ensuring structured progress control.

title: Certification Standards
content: Official certificates of completion are issued only when a student achieves a minimum 80% completion metric on course modules and completes the practical capstone assignment or oral defense seminar.

title: Refund Policy
content: Due to the proprietary nature of our curated PDFs and recorded masterclasses, enrollment fees are non-refundable once portal credentials and curriculum materials have been accessed.
